Closed date : Wed Apr 19 09:16:42 EDT 2023 Noted After following up on a complaint at 122 Brookline Ave. (Yardhouse)  of an accidental discharge of the Ansul System my findings were as follows: I met with the manager on duty at that time and made him aware of the situation. He explained to me that he was in fact the employee who accidentally hit the pull switch for the Ansul System. At the time of the visit staff were observed cleaning and sanitizing the whole cooking line and had voluntarily closed the restaurant. Management was then waiting for further notice from the Health and buildings department. No foods were affected at that time. It was then explained to management that they were not allowed to Re-open until the alarm had been reset  Ansul System recharged and approval given from both  the Building and Health Departments. Once all the work was completed and the necessary documents provided then management was to contact the City in order to dispatch an inspector to do the re-openjng of the establishment. See license # 76654 for the last detailed report.
